name: Detail Clarification (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses ClarificationRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-099, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route/factory/model files)

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewClarificationView.vue's detail mode exactly (Clarification ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid Clarification Detail with all 7 reading/text columns), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/clarification/{id} registered after /data/clarification/create (screen-119) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
UNLIKE Detail Threshing: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind

404 handled automatically by ModelNotFoundException -> ApiExceptionHandler (findOrFail) for the API controller, and via the notFound flag in DetailClarification Livewire component, same as every other detail screen in this codebase

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): aksi verifikasi langsung di layar Detail (approve/un-approve, 2026-09-14) sebelumnya TIDAK terdokumentasi sama sekali di artefak ini. backend/app/Livewire/Data/DetailClarification.php memakai trait backend/app/Livewire/Data/Concerns/HandlesRecordVerification.php (verificationModelClass()=ClarificationRecord::class) dan blade-nya merender aksi lewat canCheck()/canAcknowledge() + :message=$verificationMessage — Checked By (Supervisor/Admin) dan Acknowledged By (Mill Management/Admin). Aksi memanggil backend/app/Services/RecordVerificationService.php::setVerification() (jalur tulis keempat): peran -> cakupan mill (403) -> assertPeriodOpenForWrite('clarification', mill stasiun record, `date` record) -> 422 PERIOD_CLOSED sebelum kolom berubah -> baru tulis checked_by/acknowledged_by. Sejak fix 0594c63 HandlesRecordVerification menangkap HttpException sehingga penolakan periode tampil sebagai alert $verificationMessage (sebelumnya 422 mentah). Padanan API: PATCH /api/records/{stationType}/{id}/verification (RecordVerificationController). Diuji: backend/tests/Feature/Livewire/DetailRecordVerificationTest.php ('kunci periode: ...'; trait bersama, diwakili DetailCagesTrack), backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (422 PERIOD_CLOSED setujui & batalkan), backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist).
